constraints: Do not modify the provider source mesh in place.
Do not store provider credential values.
Do not mark the asset released without visual, slicer and physical proof.
acceptanceCriteria: Base mesh is watertight and volume-valid.
Primary curved surfaces use continuity reconstruction and measured vertex fairing rather than smooth normals only.
Loose provider fragments are removed and the printable base is one connected body.
Face screen, helmet plate and chest medallion conform to the local parent curvature.
Organic continuity and hard-feature retention are measured as separate gates.
Joint interfaces remain HOLD until semantic part separation is proven.
Silhouette gate does not regress below the configured threshold.
